title: Pullback of quotient boundaries to a filtration step
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed cochain complex and F a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], with quotient complexes and boundary subobjects as in [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For integers p,n,r with p-r+1 ≤ p, put T=F^(p-r+1)K/F^(p+1)K. The inverse image of ker(T.pOpcycles n) under the degree-n map F^pK → T equals the inverse image of B_r^(p,n) under the graded projection F^pK^n → gr^pK^n. No representative object, cycle lift, comparison morphism or B_r ≤ Z_r hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed formula for B_r before Lemma 12.24.2; categorical expansion by D3

proof.text: Put A = F^(p-r+1), P = F^p and N = F^(p+1), with N ≤ P ≤ A. Evaluation of the exact sequence N → A → A/N at each degree is exact and the quotient projections are epic, since evaluation preserves kernels and cokernels. For any x:X → P^n whose image in opcycles of A/N vanishes, the cokernel refinement theorem lifts its quotient image to an incoming differential. Lift the incoming element along A^(n-1) → (A/N)^(n-1) after an epimorphism. The difference x-dy is killed by the quotient map, so degreewise exactness lifts it to N^n after a further epimorphism. Hence x = dy+f locally on the composite epimorphic refinement. Degreewise monomorphisms follow from evaluation preserving monos, using its map-mono instance.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed formula for B_r before Lemma 12.24.2; categorical expansion by D3

proof.text: Set D = P^n intersect d(A^(n-1)) and V = D + N^n as subobjects of K^n. In the decomposition x=dy+f, f factors through N^n and hence P^n. Therefore dy=x-f factors through P^n and through the image d(A^(n-1)), so through D. The decomposition factors through V. This factorization descends along the composite epimorphism: a morphism factors through the mono V.arrow iff its composite with cokernel(V.arrow) vanishes, and epimorphisms cancel. Conversely, lift a factorization through V along the epic map D ⊞ N^n → V; lift the D component along the epic map onto the image of the incoming differential. Cancel the inclusion A^n → K^n to obtain x=dy+f in A^n. The differential term dies in opcycles, and the N term dies in A/N. Cancel the refinement epimorphism. This proves the vanishing/factorization equivalence for every generalized element x.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed formula for B_r before Lemma 12.24.2; categorical expansion by D3

proof.text: Let W be the pullback of V to P^n, and q:P^n → (P/N)^n the graded projection. Degreewise exactness identifies ker q with the image of N^n → P^n, which is contained in W. For an epimorphism q and a subobject W containing its kernel, pullback(q(W))=W. To prove this, the projection onto coker W.arrow vanishes on ker q, so descends to c on the quotient. The image q(W) is killed by c (cancel its epic image factorization); pulling it back then factors through W by the mono-cokernel kernel property. The opposite inclusion is the image/pullback adjunction. Here q(W) is complexBoundaries by its definition. Image pushforward of an image is computed by exists_obj_top and exists_obj_comp from the existing source-library API.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed formula for B_r before Lemma 12.24.2; categorical expansion by D3

proof.text: The vanishing/factorization equivalence identifies the pullback of ker pOpcycles(A/N) under P^n → (A/N)^n with W. Test the two inclusions on the arrows of the corresponding subobjects, using pullback_factors_iff and kernelSubobject_factors_iff. The saturation equality of the preceding step identifies the pullback of complexBoundaries under q with W as well. Hence the two pullbacks are equal.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_boundary_pullback (F : DecreasingFiltration K)
    (p n r : ℤ) (ha : p - r + 1 ≤ p) :
    let ht := ha.trans (Int.le_add_one (show p ≤ p from le_rfl))
    let T := F.complexQuotient (p - r + 1) (p + 1) ht
    (Subobject.pullback
      ((Subobject.ofLE (F.step p) (F.step (p - r + 1)) (F.antitone_step ha)).f n ≫
        (F.complexQuotientπ (p - r + 1) (p + 1) ht).f n)).obj
      (kernelSubobject (T.pOpcycles n)) =
    (Subobject.pullback
      ((F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (Int.le_add_one (show p ≤ p from le_rfl))).f n)).obj
      (F.complexBoundaries p n r)
